Million Hours of Creation

As connoisseurs of the arts and films ourselves, we believe no story should go untold.We provide film-makers access to the best in visual effects within arms’ reach and without costing an arm and a leg. 

Our team of creative professionals, experienced technicians, teams of artists and developers strive to uphold the idea that if it can be imagined, it can be created.

learn more
OUR SERVICES

“IT’S WHAT WE DO THAT DEFINES US”

– BATMAN (BATMAN BEGINS)

VISUAL EFFECTS

Breathe magic into your visuals at our one-stop-shop for all your visual effects needs. Manipulate your live elements or create realistic ones from scratch and merge the two together in your frame.

ANIMATION

Be it 2D or 3D, short or feature length, single or mixed formats, no project is too large or too small for our master teams of animation. From concept art to final output, the production experience is always seamless.

CONCEPT ART

Don’t fret over the never-seen-before characters, creatures, sets or prop in your story. Our Concept Art teams visualize your concepts and put pencils to paper or Wacoms to bring them to life.

PREVIZ

Go beyond Storyboarding to bring the entire cast and crew on board with your grand vision. Leave no stone unturned while planning your shots with detailed pre-viz sequences complete with set, prop and costume references and more.

VFX SUPERVISION

Seize complete control over your VFX pipeline with our VFX supervision services.
Our VFX supervisors help plan your entire production, right at the pre-production stage to save time and costs during filming and to make post-production a breeze.
